title: Create a short, visually satisfying mixed-reality stop-motion video where…
content: Create a short, visually satisfying mixed-reality stop-motion video where [DRAWN OBJECT/SKETCH] seamlessly transforms into [REAL INGREDIENT/OBJECT]. A person uses a smartphone and colored pencil on a [SURFACE], sketching each item before it magically becomes real through smooth, seamless transformations. Show [INGREDIENTS] being added to [CONTAINER], then [COOKING/BLENDING/PREPARATION ACTION], followed by serving into [DISH]. Finish with the artist sketching [TOPPINGS/FINAL DETAILS], which instantly materialize into real food, creating a vibrant, aesthetically arranged [FINAL DISH]. Use realistic textures, natural hand movements, satisfying stop-motion timing, clean composition, soft lighting, and seamless transitions between pencil drawings and real objects.

es.content: Crea un video corto de stop-motion en realidad mixta, visualmente satisfactorio, donde [DRAWN OBJECT/SKETCH] se transforma sin esfuerzo en [REAL INGREDIENT/OBJECT]. Una persona usa un smartphone y un lápiz de color sobre una [SURFACE], dibujando cada elemento antes de que mágicamente se vuelva real mediante transformaciones suaves y fluidas. Muestra cómo se añaden [INGREDIENTS] a [CONTAINER], luego [COOKING/BLENDING/PREPARATION ACTION], seguido de servir en [DISH]. Termina con el artista dibujando [TOPPINGS/FINAL DETAILS], que se materializan al instante como comida real, creando un vibrante [FINAL DISH] dispuesto de forma estética. Usa texturas realistas, movimientos naturales de las manos, un timing de stop-motion satisfactorio, composición limpia, iluminación suave y transiciones fluidas entre los dibujos a lápiz y los objetos reales.

fr.content: Créez une courte vidéo stop-motion en mixed reality, visuellement satisfaisante, dans laquelle [DRAWN OBJECT/SKETCH] se transforme de manière fluide en [REAL INGREDIENT/OBJECT]. Une personne utilise un smartphone et un crayon de couleur sur une [SURFACE], esquissant chaque élément avant qu’il ne devienne magiquement réel grâce à des transformations douces et parfaitement fluides. Montrez [INGREDIENTS] ajoutés à [CONTAINER], puis [COOKING/BLENDING/PREPARATION ACTION], avant de servir dans [DISH]. Terminez avec l’artiste en train de dessiner [TOPPINGS/FINAL DETAILS], qui se matérialisent instantanément en véritable nourriture, créant un [FINAL DISH] vibrant et disposé de façon esthétique. Utilisez des textures réalistes, des mouvements naturels des mains, un timing stop-motion satisfaisant, une composition épurée, un éclairage doux et des transitions fluides entre les dessins au crayon et les objets réels.

ja.content:
---
[DRAWN OBJECT/SKETCH] が [REAL INGREDIENT/OBJECT] に自然に変化する、短くて視覚的に心地よい mixed-reality の stop-motion video を作成してください。人物が [SURFACE] の上で smartphone と colored pencil を使い、各アイテムをスケッチすると、それが滑らかでシームレスな transformation によって魔法のように本物になります。[INGREDIENTS] が [CONTAINER] に加えられ、続いて [COOKING/BLENDING/PREPARATION ACTION]、その後 [DISH] に盛り付けられる様子を見せてください。最後に、アーティストが [TOPPINGS/FINAL DETAILS] をスケッチし、それが即座に本物の food として具現化し、鮮やかで美しく整えられた [FINAL DISH] を作り上げます。realistic textures、自然な手の動き、心地よい stop-motion のタイミング、clean composition、soft lighting、そして pencil drawings と real objects の間の seamless transitions を使用してください。
---

ko.content:
---
[DRAWN OBJECT/SKETCH]가 [REAL INGREDIENT/OBJECT]로 자연스럽게 변하는, 짧고 시각적으로 만족스러운 mixed-reality stop-motion video를 만들어라. 한 사람이 [SURFACE] 위에서 스마트폰과 색연필을 사용해 각 항목을 스케치한 뒤, 부드럽고 매끄러운 변환을 통해 마법처럼 실제로 바뀌게 한다. [INGREDIENTS]를 [CONTAINER]에 넣고, 이어서 [COOKING/BLENDING/PREPARATION ACTION]을 한 다음, [DISH]에 담아 서빙하는 모습을 보여라. 마지막에는 아티스트가 [TOPPINGS/FINAL DETAILS]를 스케치하고, 그것이 즉시 실제 음식으로 구현되어 생동감 있고 미적으로 잘 배치된 [FINAL DISH]를 완성한다. 사실적인 질감, 자연스러운 손동작, 만족스러운 stop-motion 타이밍, 깔끔한 구도, 부드러운 조명, 그리고 연필 드로잉과 실제 오브젝트 사이의 매끄러운 전환을 사용하라.

pt.content: Crie um vídeo curto de stop-motion em mixed reality, visualmente satisfatório, no qual [DRAWN OBJECT/SKETCH] se transforma perfeitamente em [REAL INGREDIENT/OBJECT]. Uma pessoa usa um smartphone e um lápis de cor sobre uma [SURFACE], desenhando cada item antes que ele magicamente se torne real por meio de transformações suaves e contínuas. Mostre [INGREDIENTS] sendo adicionados a [CONTAINER], depois [COOKING/BLENDING/PREPARATION ACTION], seguido de servir em [DISH]. Finalize com o artista desenhando [TOPPINGS/FINAL DETAILS], que instantaneamente se materializam em comida real, criando um [FINAL DISH] vibrante e esteticamente organizado. Use texturas realistas, movimentos naturais das mãos, timing satisfatório de stop-motion, composição limpa, iluminação suave e transições perfeitas entre desenhos a lápis e objetos reais.

zh.content: 创建一段简短、视觉上令人满足的混合现实定格动画视频，其中 [DRAWN OBJECT/SKETCH] 无缝变形为 [REAL INGREDIENT/OBJECT]。一位人物在 [SURFACE] 上使用智能手机和彩色铅笔，先勾画出每个物品，然后它们通过流畅、无缝的转变神奇地变成真实物体。展示 [INGREDIENTS] 被加入 [CONTAINER]，接着进行 [COOKING/BLENDING/PREPARATION ACTION]，然后盛入 [DISH]。最后，艺术家勾画 [TOPPINGS/FINAL DETAILS]，这些内容会立即实体化为真实食物，呈现出一份充满活力、摆盘美观的 [FINAL DISH]。使用真实质感、自然的手部动作、令人满足的定格动画节奏、干净的构图、柔和的光线，以及铅笔绘图与真实物体之间无缝衔接的转场。
